memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: Brothers and sisters, if someone is caught in a sin, you who live by the Spirit should restore that person gently. But watch yourselves, or you also may be tempted. — Galatians 6:1

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Vehicle side mirrors reveal blind spots and hidden dangers that we cannot see directly. Driving without them can turn a small mistake into a major accident. Similarly, our spiritual journey has "blind spots"—unknown weaknesses, overlooked wrong paths, and hidden hazards. To reveal these, God places true, God-fearing friends and counselors in our lives.
Many mirrors carry the warning, "Objects in the mirror are closer than they appear." Likewise, the warnings of friends can reveal that dangers, which seem distant to us, are actually very close. If we listen to them and make corrections, our spiritual journey will be safe and fruitful

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "A true friend stands by you when you are wrong, because anyone will stand by you when you are right." — Arnold H. Glasow

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You for the bold and loving friends You have placed in my life to speak the truth and warn me. Grant me the humility to accept their corrections and the wisdom to set my path right. May my journey be safe according to Your will. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May your life be free from hidden dangers, and may the voices that guide you
